title: MERICS Media Briefing: Xi Jinping visits the USA
gist: Announcement of a MERICS video briefing ahead of Xi Jinping's 24 September White House meeting with Trump, flagging AI and trade as top agenda items and stressing that the summit precedes the October deadline for EU-China trade negotiations, with significant ramifications for Brussels.

insights.claim: Artificial intelligence and bilateral trade relations are expected to feature high on the agenda of Xi Jinping's 24 September 2026 White House meeting with Donald Trump.
insights.speaker: MERICS
insights.so_what: AI and trade outcomes from the summit could move chip and export-control-exposed equities.
insights.quote: Artificial Intelligence is expected to feature high on the agenda as are the two countries' trade relations.
insights.locator: Chinese President Xi Jinping is set

insights.claim: The Trump-Xi meeting takes place just before the October deadline for EU-China trade negotiations, so its outcome will significantly shape Brussels' China policy.
insights.speaker: MERICS
insights.so_what: US-China deal terms may set the bargaining floor for EU-China trade talks and tariff decisions.
insights.quote: Whatever comes out of Xi’s trip to Washington will have significant ramifications for Brussels’ China policy.
insights.locator: Chinese President Xi Jinping is set
